args.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational inventory illustration. Create a matching TWO-STATE family for a minimalist Mars survival game. Reference1 is the desired visibly icy cylindrical drill core and exact viewing orientation. Reference2 is material reference ONLY for the thin reused foil/felt insulating wrap; do not copy its different orientation or heavy opaque bag. Output one 1536x1024 transparent canvas with TWO separate full objects, upper row then lower row, generous gutters and no lettering. BOTH objects have exactly the same length, long-axis angle (left end higher, right end lower, about 8 degrees downward to the right), perspective, and right circular cut face visible. The upper is the freshly cut LOCAL ICE CORE: visibly translucent blue-white solid ice, a few tiny scattered rusty-brown mineral flecks (no continuous brown band), subtle fractures and frost, flat circular sawn ends. A very thin optically clear protective film may be shown only as a restrained highlight along the edge; ice must dominate its appearance. No opaque pouch, plastic seam flaps, cap, label, frame, flange or other packaging. The lower is THAT EXACT SAME ICE CYLINDER in the SAME orientation and at the SAME physical scale, now wrapped snugly in one thin reused silver foil-backed felt sheet, tied by a single narrow plain cloth strip around its middle. The wrap is modest and soft, only slightly increases the diameter, no hard case or hardware. Keep its right icy circular end visibly recognizable through the still-clear film, with a narrow soft insulation rim; do not cap that end with foil, a tag or an opaque disk. The lower must unmistakably look like wrapping the upper, without rotating it or changing which end faces us. Match reference1's clean softly painted physical realism, white-blue frosted highlights against Mars brown backgrounds. At game scale each full object will be about96pixelswide, so strong visible ice and simple wrap silhouettes matter. No scene, ground, cast shadow, glow, diagram, numbers, readable text, blue metal, brass, handles, screws or decorative fittings. Real transparent background outside both silhouettes. No extra objects.
